question:
Find the value of x in the given expression.

 (x)/(2.1) + (4.2)/(6.3) = 4
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

4.2 / 6.3 = 2/3

x/2.1 + 2/3 = 4

x/2.1 = 4 − 2/3 = 10/3

x = (10/3) × 2.1 = (10/3) × (21/10) = 7

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x/2.1 + 4.2/6.3 = 4

**Formula used:**

Simplification of fractions

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4.2/6.3 = 42/63 = 2/3

⇒ Equation becomes:

x/2.1 + 2/3 = 4

⇒ x/2.1 = 4 − 2/3

⇒ = (12 − 2)/3 = 10/3

⇒ x = (10/3) × 2.1

⇒ = (10/3) × (21/10)

⇒ = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**
